scope: Aggregate TREE_ALPHA and FRUIT_ALPHA simulation compatibility only; no species-specific agronomy.

threshold_parameters.rationale: Life Runtime V1 requires plant support of at least 0.35 and defines TREE_ALPHA water default 0.70.
threshold_parameters.risk: Normalized support is not liters and must not be physically interpreted.

threshold_parameters.rationale: Life Runtime V1 plant support gate and TREE_ALPHA default are retained in owner-native normalized units.
threshold_parameters.risk: This fraction has no reviewed conversion to irradiance.

threshold_parameters.rationale: Life Runtime V1 plant support gate and TREE_ALPHA soil nutrient default are retained.
threshold_parameters.risk: This support score is distinct from Ecology nutrients_kg.

threshold_parameters.rationale: Exact Life Runtime V1 generic plant compatibility range with TREE_ALPHA default temperature.
threshold_parameters.risk: Generic owner range is not a species-specific orchard threshold.

threshold_parameters.rationale: Ecology V1 marks fertility below 0.35 as low; the default crosswalk uses TREE_ALPHA nutrient support without changing units.
threshold_parameters.risk: The 0.72 cross-owner default requires future adapter validation even though both owners use 0..1 fractions.

threshold_parameters.rationale: TREE_ALPHA defaults to zero disease pressure and Life Runtime V1 classifies pressure above 0.60 as active disease.
threshold_parameters.risk: The generic pressure proxy does not model a real pathogen or treatment.

threshold_parameters.rationale: Exact Agriculture Alpha FRUIT owner-native energy rate.
threshold_parameters.risk: It must not be mixed with Ecology energy_proxy or physical energy.
